description:
One keyboard and mouse across two Windows PCs, with screens laid out in millimetres.

DeskStitch is a software KVM for two Windows PCs. Screens are laid out on a desk map in millimetres,
read from each monitor's physical size, so a 4K screen next to a 1440p screen line up exactly as they
stand on the desk: no dead zones, same cursor speed everywhere. Pairing code, encrypted LAN link,
clipboard for text and images, optional audio sharing, jump keys. Free 7-day trial, then a one-time license for the host PC;
the second PC never needs a key.
